name: sitting feet together reach forward stretch
description: Sitting with your soles together and reaching forward stretches your back and inner thighs. A gentle hip and back opener.
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and your knees falling out.
Hold your feet and fold forward from your hips, keeping your spine long.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
